look.why: A soft twilight lavender-purple that complements the warm coral-terracotta skin and pale suction cups.

size.measure: total arm span 0.6–1.0 m, up to 1.3 m

habitat.text: Coastal rocky reefs, seagrass beds, and sandy seafloors across temperate and tropical oceans worldwide.

diet.text: Crabs, lobsters, clams, scallops, snails, and small benthic fish.

facts.text: Has three hearts, blue copper-based blood, and roughly two-thirds of its neurons distributed inside its eight arms.
Can match both the color and bumpy texture of surrounding rocks in less than a second using chromatophores and papillae.
